mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we have clear skies and a temperature of 57 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, an elevated air quality index of 74, a waxing gibbous moon, and an overnight low of 45 degrees with no rain expected; also, keep an eye out for the space station tonight as it rises in the west over Mount Horeb and heads toward Madison near Home Depot.

The city is currently working on Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction project, where underground utility work is finished and concrete work is now underway on the west block of Mark Drive and Todd Street, with final paving planned for next spring. Additionally, residents can check the city website to sign up for the Eye on Water program to monitor utility usage.

There is a busy schedule this week with Hop Haus Trivia today at Hop Haus Brewing Co. and Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company today as well. Tomorrow, look forward to Yoga at Insight Wellness, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.

Regarding local public safety, the Verona Police Department released a report on October 15, 2026, detailing the arrest of a school bus driver for O W I after officers observed erratic driving and confirmed the driver was impaired, though fortunately, no students were injured during the encounter.
Today is the perfect day to grab a scoop of the Devil's Food Cake flavor of the day at Culver's, which is currently open and serving customers until 10:00 PM tonight.
